purpose: Estimate aggregate and permitted-segment treatment uplift after a validated randomized experiment with explicit overlap and sensitivity diagnostics.
limitations: AIPW depends on randomized-design integrity, overlap and correctly logged treatment propensity.
The bounded bias analysis is a scenario diagnostic, not proof against all unmeasured confounding.
Segment estimates require prespecification and sufficient samples in both arms.
Synthetic estimates cannot support causal interpretation or marketplace action.
rollback: Discard the uplift report and display only versioned observational attribution with no incremental or causal wording.
